arguments.summary: APT-29 (Cozy Bear) activity detected originating from a spearphishing attachment delivered via a compromised partner email. The threat actor established persistence on a domain controller (10.0.8.200) using a scheduled task and initiated C2 beaconing to known malicious infrastructure at 198.51.100.77. Lateral movement observed from workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) via SMB and Kerberos exploitation. Despite detection, containment actions were denied due to policy restrictions and lack of integration with critical systems.

IDS alert: Cobalt Strike beaconing detected from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.

Lateral movement confirmed: successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50.

Containment attempts failed: firewall block, EDR isolation, and IAM lockout actions denied due to policy misconfiguration and system integration gaps.

rule Packed_UPX_With_AntiVM {
    meta:
        description = "Detects UPX-packed binaries with anti-VM artifacts"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.upx"
        malpedia_version = "20260411"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal"
    strings:
        $upx = "UPX!" ascii
        $anti_vm = "VMware" ascii wide
        $anti_vm2 = "VirtualBox" ascii wide
    condition:
        $upx and ($anti_vm or $anti_vm2)
}
